units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:9">Ḥall. I, 9</cite> <he>רְחִיצַת ידים</he> washing the hands.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 7:4:3">Y. Naz. VII, end, 56ᵈ</cite> <he>על רחיצת גופו</he> for omitting to bathe his body.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1">Num. R. s. 14<sup>1</sup></cite> <he>שרפאתיו ע״י רחיצת הירדן</he> whom I cured by bathing in the Jordan.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שהסרתי … ע״י רחיצת וכ׳</he> whom I saved from drowning through the bathing of Pharaoh’s daughter.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:1">Ib.</cite> <he>גחזי שלקה ע״י ר׳</he> Gehazi who was punished on the occasion of (Naaman’s) bathing; a. fr.
